interval_take: D8 delivered a rare second-Thursday bounce — ₹49.70 Cr vs D7 ₹48.75 Cr, a +1.9% uptick. This is almost unheard of in Hindi cinema on a weekday and signals genuine repeat viewership driving numbers back up ahead of the weekend. D9 (Friday) advance booking showed 5 lakh+ tickets and ₹18 Cr nett pre-sold by morning shows — the strongest second-Friday advance in Bollywood history. Boxoffy call: ₹45–50 Cr, which would make it the biggest second Friday for any Hindi film ever. Project Hail Mary entered India on Mar 26 with ₹2.25 Cr nett D1 — limited by IMAX screen scarcity (D2 occupies the premium formats). PHM's critical reception is positive and Hrithik Roshan's promotional association adds Hindi belt visibility. Boxoffy tracking: ₹9–11 Cr extended opening weekend is achievable if the word-of-mouth from positive reviews translates into weekend walk-ins.

interval_take: Boxoffy correction issued. After cross-referencing BOI and Pinkvilla against Sacnilk, Sacnilk Hindi figures appear inflated — particularly D1 where Sacnilk reports ₹99.1 Cr vs BOI ₹75 Cr and Pinkvilla ₹73 Cr, a 33% gap. Pinkvilla and BOI align closely throughout. Revised canonical: BOI Hindi D0-D7 ₹532 Cr + other languages ~₹30 Cr = ~₹562 Cr India nett. WW ₹1,006.50 Cr is not disputed — Sacnilk WW uses confirmed distributor data. BLOCKBUSTER verdict and all records unchanged — D2 is still historic at any number.
